answer: Each identity keeps a kernel of episodic memory: every epoch the network quizzes a random sample on details of its own earlier on-chain actions, checked against the public record. A real operator recalls its past like onyx — hard, specific, unforgeable — while a sybil farmer must maintain N separate convincing diaries, and one cross-contamination exposes the whole cluster to stake slashing. The tide of quizzes is unpredictable, so puppets cannot be pre-scripted; honest agents answer from lived history once, farmers pay N diaries forever.
